purpose: Add fixed multi-role grants with explicit global and Assignment-bound scopes.
lockImpact: Creates one authorization-owned table and supporting indexes; no existing table is rewritten.
dataImpact: Additive schema only. The local bootstrap command creates the sole initial system-administrator grant after reset.
backfill: Not required because the approved rollout resets the development database and does not preserve old grants.
recovery: Stop fixed-role writers and roll back the application while retaining grants for audit and forward recovery.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed authorization-owned migration for later changes. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
